description: This PHP class 'BuzzAnniversaryDao' provides data access methods for retrieving upcoming employee anniversaries, including listing and counting anniversaries based on search filter parameters. It interacts with the database using query builders and handles pagination.

classes.name: BuzzAnniversaryDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for employee anniversary data, providing methods to retrieve upcoming anniversaries and their count.

methods.name: getUpcomingAnniversariesList
methods.description: Returns a list of upcoming employee anniversaries based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getUpcomingAnniversariesPaginator
methods.description: Creates and returns a paginator object for upcoming anniversaries, applying filtering and sorting.

methods.name: getUpcomingAnniversariesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of upcoming employee anniversaries based on search filter parameters.
